subject: Brant
object: talk to Brant right after exiting the cave
text: Brant must be talked to as soon as everyone is teleported outside the cave, or the Alumina is not obtained and he stays in place unable to progress.

evidence.quote: You need to talk to Brant as soon everyone teleports outside the cave, or you wont get the Alumina, he will just stay there, and obviously wont be able to progress.

subject: Brant
object: warping to Marse after exiting the cave
text: Warping to Marse right after leaving the cave leaves Brant behind, and the player must return to the cave to pick him up again.

evidence.quote: I warped to Marse as soon we got out, assuming he would follow but nope...had to get back to the cave to get him again.

subject: Holes, Holes, and a Brant
text: This achievement is regular story progression and cannot be missed if the story is followed.

evidence.quote: This is regular progression. You can't miss it if you're following the story.
